entities.name: André Gueye
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: André Guèye is a Senegalese Catholic prelate who was appointed as the 5th Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Dakar, Senegal on 22 February 2025. Before that, from 18 January 2013 until 22 February 2025, he was the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Thiès, Senegal. He serves as the Apostolic Administrator of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Saint-Louis du Sénégal since 12 January 2023. He was appointed bishop on 18 January 2013 by Pope Benedict XVI and was consecrated at Thiès on 25 May 2013. His installation as Archbishop of Dakar took place on 3 May 2025.
